options.label: A Later lane with promote / drop
options.act: Wishlist rendered as a Later lane; promote/drop recorded
options.then: Show the wishlist as a Later lane, where promote and drop stick.

why: The wishlist shows as a Later lane: at a phase's start or gate I mark what fits; you promote or drop, and the choice sticks, so dropped ideas don't come back (HEY Screener). WISHLIST.md stays the file it's written in; the board shows it.
